$comment: Complexity and size ratchet, enforced by `npm run complexity:check` (scripts/check-complexity.mjs). Functions and files must stay within `limits` (`lines` is code lines per function, `fileLines` code lines per file, both excluding blank and comment lines). `functions` and `files` list the documented exceptions: each is pinned at its measured score, may only go down, and must give a `reason`. Lower scores with `npm run complexity:update`; a new exception needs `npm run complexity:update -- --accept` plus a `reason`, both visible in review.

src/hub/DocumentsApp.tsx::DocumentsApp.reason: Documents hub container: wires repo selection, the lazy file tree and the active document into PrShell in one render. Its hooks already live in their own modules; splitting the JSX would scatter one layout.

src/hub/DocumentsHubApp.tsx::DocumentsHu.reason: Hub root inside the Azure DevOps SDK: boot, repo discovery, routing and deep links feeding one PrShell. Logic is extracted to tested modules; what remains is the wiring that only runs in the host.

src/hub/RepoPicker.tsx::RepoPicker.reason: Repository dropdown: search box, listbox markup and keyboard navigation that share focus state. Kept whole so the ARIA listbox reads in one place.

src/hub/markdownReader.tsx::MarkdownRead.reason: Hub reader container: connects file loading, history and routing to PrShell. Mostly prop wiring with little branching.

src/pr-tab/PrTabApp.tsx::PrTabApp.reason: PR tab root inside the Azure DevOps SDK: boot states, PR context, update comparison and routing into PrShell. Logic is extracted to tested modules; the rest is host wiring.

src/shell/PrShell.tsx::PrShell.reason: Reader root: composes about 25 single-purpose hooks and the nav, article and rail panes. Complexity is 6/2; the length is the wiring list itself.

src/shell/components/ArticleView.tsx::Ar.reason: Rendered article: owns the DOM refs that highlight wrapping, selection and click delegation act on. Effect bodies and handlers are extracted; the component wires them to one element tree.

src/shell/components/Balloon.tsx::Balloo.reason: Comment thread card: header, comment list, reply composer and actions share the thread state. One self-contained card.

src/shell/components/CommentFilterMenu.t.reason: Filter menu: status modes, file-scope toggle and menu keyboard handling share open/focus state and one ARIA menu.

src/shell/components/CommentRail.tsx::Co.reason: Comment rail layout: positions threads against article anchors and hosts the draft balloon and tray. Layout math is in CommentRail.layout.ts; this is the render that applies it.

src/shell/components/CommentRow.tsx::Com.reason: Single comment: author line, body or edit mode, reactions and actions menu share edit state. Hooks and parts are already split out.

src/shell/components/Composer.tsx::Compo.reason: Comment editor: textarea, @-mention typeahead, keyboard shortcuts and image paste all act on the same text and caret. Splitting would pass the caret state around.

src/shell/components/DiffMinimap.tsx::Di.reason: Diff minimap: change markers, thumb drag and scroll sync act on one scroll container. Geometry lives in diffMinimap.helpers.ts.

src/shell/components/DocNav.rows.tsx::Di.reason: Folder row in the navigation tree: twist button, label, badges and ARIA treeitem attributes for one row.

src/shell/components/DocNav.rows.tsx::Fi.reason: File row in the navigation tree: label, change icon, comment badge, outline toggle and ARIA treeitem attributes for one row.

src/shell/components/DocNav.search.tsx::.reason: Navigation search results: result rows with keyboard selection and ARIA listbox semantics in one list.

src/shell/components/DocNav.tsx::DocNav.reason: Navigation pane: tree, search and outline share selection, expansion and keyboard state. Rows, header, search and model are in DocNav.* modules.

src/shell/components/GeneratedSourceModa.reason: Generated-source dialog: header, view toggle and source/diff panes share the dialog state and focus trap.

src/shell/components/IterationPicker.tsx.reason: PR update picker: update listbox, comparison range and keyboard handling share selection state and one ARIA listbox.

src/shell/components/MentionPicker.tsx::.reason: Mention typeahead: suggestion list, highlighted row and keyboard selection for one ARIA listbox.
One mention suggestion: avatar, name, secondary text and match highlighting with its ARIA option attributes.

src/shell/components/ReaderLoadingShell..reason: Boot skeleton: static placeholder markup that mirrors the reader layout so nothing shifts on load. No logic to extract.

src/shell/components/ReaderStatusBar.tsx.reason: Status bar: composes its regions (comparison, comments, reading preferences, refresh) from ReaderStatusBar.parts.

src/shell/components/ReadingPreferencesC.reason: Reading preferences popover: font, size, spacing and width controls bound to one preferences object.

src/hub/DocumentsHubApp.tsx.reason: Contains only the DocumentsHubApp component (a documented exception, about 556 lines) and its imports; everything else was moved out.

src/shell/PrShell.tsx.reason: Contains only the PrShell component (a documented exception, about 509 lines) and its imports; everything else was moved out.
